title: H 5248 (126th General Assembly): Limited term driver's licenses and identification cards
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 2 (7-13-710(A)(1)-(2))
(quote) (1) South Carolina driver's license that does not contain the words "Limited Term"; or (2) other form of identification containing a photograph issued by the Department of Motor Vehicles, provided, that it does not contain the words "Limited Term"
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1 (56-1-140(A))
(quote) Qualified applicants who are not citizens of the United States must have "Limited Term" conspicuously included on the drivers' licenses or identification cards issued to them.
(section) Sec. 3 (56-1-230(A)(3))
(quote) becoming a citizen of the United States after once providing the Department of Motor Vehicles with documentation that he was not a citizen of the United States
(other) Sec. 3 (56-1-230): licence and ID card holders must notify the DMV within ten days of a move, name change, or becoming a citizen; DMV may require documents; one free replacement card per issuance cycle.
(other) Sec. 4: Sections 1 and 2 effective on approval; Section 3 one year after approval.
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2026-02-24). Slot a: the DMV licence and DMV photo ID on the 7-13-710(A) list are not accepted if they carry the words 'Limited Term'; the other three items (passport, military ID, voter registration card with photograph) are reprinted unchanged.
(other) note: Strike/new markers restored from the HTML styling (the saved .txt had none). Section 3's wording is split across strike and new text in the saved version; the quote is the new item (3) words. Only the introduced text is saved.
